diagnostic.rss_note: Host process RSS is not unique guest physical bytes; aliases may be counted; sampling can miss instantaneous peak.
diagnostic.mapped_estimate_note: Trace-derived estimate, excludes initial ELF pages and PROT_NONE file pages; overlapping successful mmap/mprotect ranges unioned; not a physical/RSS measurement. All benchmark threads share one address space.
diagnostic.quota_note: Memory::map bounds committed mapping bytes by the logical per-space limit. Initial ELF and some PROT_NONE file mapping pages are absent from the trace reconstruction.
